mapper.sql: select bw_inventory_batch.id, bw_cargo.cargo_name, bw_cargo.merge_code, bw_cargo.specification, bw_inventory_batch.batch_no as inventory_batch_no, bw_inventory_batch.unit_id, bw_inventory_batch.expired_date, bw_inventory_batch.factory_batch_no, bw_inventory_batch.produce_date, bw_inventory_batch.hydration, bw_inventory_batch.no_hydration_content, bw_inventory_batch.report_no, bw_inventory_batch.licence_no from bw_inventory_batch left join bw_cargo on bw_inventory_batch.cargo_id = bw_cargo.id

select.where:
bw_inventory_batch.is_deleted = 0 and bw_cargo.is_deleted = 0
and bw_cargo.cargo_name like concat('%', #{pageQuery.cargoName}, '%')
and bw_cargo.merge_code like concat('%', #{pageQuery.mergeCode}, '%')
and bw_inventory_batch.batch_no like concat('%', #{pageQuery.inventoryBatchNo}, '%')
and bw_inventory_batch.id in
#{item}
and 1 = -1
order by bw_inventory_batch.create_time desc

mapper.select:
select bw_inventory_batch.id, bw_inventory_batch.batch_no as inventory_batch_no, ifnull(s.available_quantity, 0) as available_quantity, ifnull(s.reserve_quantity, 0) as reserve_quantity, bw_inventory_batch.unit_id, bw_inventory_batch.expired_date from bw_inventory_batch left join (select bw_inventory_batch.batch_no, bw_inventory_batch.cargo_id, sum(available_quantity) as available_quantity, sum(reserve_quantity) as reserve_quantity from bw_inventory left join bw_inventory_batch on bw_inventory.inventory_batch_id = bw_inventory_batch.id where bw_inventory.is_deleted = 0 and bw_inventory_batch.is_deleted = 0
and bw_inventory.cargo_id = #{pageQuery.cargoId}
and bw_inventory_batch.batch_no like concat('%', #{pageQuery.inventoryBatchNo}, '%')
and bw_inventory.available_quantity != 0 group by bw_inventory_batch.batch_no) s on bw_inventory_batch.batch_no = s.batch_no and bw_inventory_batch.cargo_id = s.cargo_id where bw_inventory_batch.is_deleted = 0
and bw_inventory_batch.cargo_id = #{pageQuery.cargoId}
and bw_inventory_batch.batch_no like concat('%', #{pageQuery.inventoryBatchNo}, '%')
order by bw_inventory_batch.create_time desc

select ib.id, ib.cargo_id, ib.batch_no as materialBatchNo, ib.factory_batch_no,ib.produce_date,ib.expired_date, ib.hydration,ib.no_hydration_content,ib.unit_id,ib.report_no,ib.licence_no,cargo.cargo_name as materialName, cargo.merge_code,cargo.supplier,cargo.producer, ifnull(s.available_quantity, 0) as available_quantity, ifnull(s.reserve_quantity, 0) as reserve_quantity,cargo.specification from bw_inventory_batch ib left join (select bw_inventory_batch.batch_no, bw_inventory_batch.cargo_id, sum(available_quantity) as available_quantity, sum(reserve_quantity) as reserve_quantity from bw_inventory left join bw_inventory_batch on bw_inventory.inventory_batch_id = bw_inventory_batch.id where bw_inventory.is_deleted = 0 and bw_inventory_batch.is_deleted = 0 and bw_inventory_batch.is_deleted = 0 and bw_inventory.available_quantity != 0 group by bw_inventory_batch.id) s on ib.batch_no = s.batch_no and ib.cargo_id = s.cargo_id left join bw_cargo cargo on ib.cargo_id = cargo.id
cargo.is_deleted = 0 and s.available_quantity IS NOT NULL and s.available_quantity > 0 and ib.available = 1
and cargo.platform_material_id in
#{item}
order by ib.expired_date ASC

select bw_inventory_batch.id as business_id, bw_inventory_batch.batch_no, bw_cargo.cargo_name, bw_cargo.cargo_code, bw_cargo.merge_code, bw_cargo.specification as cargo_specification from bw_inventory_batch left join bw_cargo on bw_inventory_batch.cargo_id = bw_cargo.id where bw_inventory_batch.is_deleted = 0 and bw_cargo.is_deleted = 0
and bw_inventory_batch.id in
#{item}
and 1 = -1
